expectedBasis: Frozen previous actual four-node draft coordinates and hand-authored aligned chains, branch/merge, blocked, reverse and move/history scenarios. Current product outputs are observations only.

surface.draftFlow: draftFlow(draft) => horizontal | vertical; no-edge horizontal default
surface.portPoint: portPoint(node,module,portId,flow=horizontal); old three arguments preserve side-port coordinates
surface.draftRoutes: draftRoutes(draft,catalog) => routes,overlaps,flow; UI committed/pending circles use the same flow

literalFrozenVerticalChain.claim: Unobstructed aligned chain has zero bends, one route per canonical authored edge; no model/node/parameter/identity mutation. Pending start and public SVG endpoint/circle consistency require separate native evidence.

horizontalLiteral.claim: Horizontal graphs and no-edge drafting retain left-to-right side ports. Direction scoring implementation is not copied into oracle.

branchMerge: Topological producers fork into two identities and reconverge on distinct Add left/right and Concat a/b ports. In vertical arrangement ports are distinct, catalog ordered on top edge; same producer fanout remains allowed, independent producers never coalesce. Fixture clear paths do not cross node interiors or each other except a shared fanout endpoint/trunk.
routing: Endpoints stay on projected port boundary; paths orthogonal, no body penetration when a feasible route exists. Reverse positioned graph must leave source outward and approach target from outside; blocked covers remain reported by blockedBy/overlaps, never masked as successful clear routing. No arbitrary optimal/global aesthetic claim.
history: Four-direction moves keep exact nonposition node facts and edge identities, one undo per move, undo/redo byte-equivalent geometry and persisted JSON stable. Translation equivariance and array/edge insertion order independence tested where input geometry/topology is identical.
hitRegion: Native acceptance must include both visible circle and port label/bounding-center clicks, outward pending start, distinct merge port identity, successful edge once and invalid duplicate producer rejection; pure routing tests do not certify hit boxes.
limits: No new schema or semantic/source change
No model execution or inferred runtime tensor claims
No full suite/build rerun by this auditor
AI trials never count as human participants
Dense arbitrary graphs/global shortest route/full human usability remain uncertified
extension: Cases11-13 require returned flow to match actual projected route literals; click region fully covers radius5 dot and 9-unit dot-label gap, has positive finite bounds and >=20height for single port; two catalog merge inputs never capture each other dot/gap.
